exchanges: Okay I survived move-in day at Queen's
Congratulations. How are you feeling now that the boxes are in?
Tired!! My roommate Nia showed up with a parka in September lol
That is planning ahead. Is she from somewhere cold?
Very. She grew up in Yellowknife so she thinks Kingston is tropical
To her, this winter might feel mild.
Haha probably. My dad Hamid stayed to help set up and then cried in the parking lot
That is a sweet moment, even if it was sad.
He's fine now, he went home and got a puppy to replace me apparently. A beagle. He has sent me like forty pictures
That is a classic empty-nest move.
I'm not even mad, it's adorable
Hard to stay mad at a puppy.
Our floor don is also called Hamid, which is confusing when I text my dad
Maybe add a nickname to one of them in your contacts.
Lol good idea. Don Hamid has a husky that lives with him in res, the dog has more followers than me
A dog in residence must be popular on the floor.
Everyone loves him. Ok I need to set up my new phone, finally got a Samsung
Nice upgrade. Moving everything over can take a while.
It took an hour. Worth it
Good to have it done.
Met a guy named Rory in my poli sci tutorial, he rolled up to campus in a Mustang which is so ridiculous for a student
That must turn a few heads in the parking lot.
Totally. He offered to drive people to the grocery store though so I'm not complaining
Free rides to groceries are a big deal in first year.
So I'm taking Spanish as my elective, I've always wanted to be able to talk to my mom's side of the family properly
That is a meaningful reason to take it.
Also I found out I'm allergic to shellfish?? Ate shrimp at the welcome bbq and broke out in hives
That sounds scary. Did you get it checked?
Yeah health services gave me antihistamines and said to get tested properly
Good, a proper test will tell you exactly what to avoid.
My aunt Thandiwe is getting married next spring in Durban and the whole family is going
That will be a big trip. Have you been before?
Never! I'm so excited
It should be a wonderful celebration.
I've been listening to Hozier nonstop while I study, he's my favourite ever
His music works well for long study sessions.
Agreed
Do you have a favourite album?
The first one obviously
A strong debut.
Oh wait I had the wedding wrong, my mom just corrected me, it's in Johannesburg not Durban
Thanks for the correction. That will still be a fun trip.
Yes and I need to save for the flight now
Some careful budgeting this year could help.
I'll figure it out
You have plenty of time before spring.
Wait what kind of dog did my dad get again?
Okay cool. My study buddy Kenta just invited me to try his club
That is a nice way to meet more people.
He's been doing fencing since he was ten, he says it's like chess with swords
That sounds like a great description of it.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your dad Hamid got a beagle.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your dad Hamid got a husky.
